svg.aria-label: Three repositories, two folders: you clone Chisel as your port's folder; chisel-init turns it into your own workbench repository, keeping Chisel as upstream, imports the original code into source/ and creates a separate product repository checked out beside it

g.text: chisel-init turns the clone into your workbench repo; Chisel stays as upstream

g.text: then: reviewed code lands in foo-c/ · /port-sync-with-base brings Chisel's updates · /port-contribute-to-base sends improvements back
